create_MetricLogger: create a MetricLogger instance to track training metrics with tab-delimited output and optional file logging
update_MetricLogger_meters: update the MetricLogger meters with new metric values passed as keyword arguments including torch tensors
log_every_MetricLogger: log training progress every N iterations using log_every as a generator that yields items from an iterable
create_SmoothedValue: create a SmoothedValue tracker with a configurable window size to compute median, average, and max of recent values
synchronize_SmoothedValue: synchronize SmoothedValue count and total across distributed processes using torch distributed all_reduce
